system.description:
A collection of tools and devices to aid in climbing sheer surfaces, mountains, cliffs, and collapsing ruins. It contains a sturdy climbing axe, several pitons that can be wedged into cracks, a length of synth-rope, and a pair of grip-gloves that enhance the wearer’s grip and allow them to hold on to objects and surfaces more effectively.

These reduce the Difficulty of all Might (Move) tests to climb by 1 and allow a character to attempt a Skill Test to climb surfaces that might not be possible to climb otherwise.
